detail.name: "Non-Business Card"
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Zhao's Mindscape: No Value Has Its Own Value
detail.desc2:
A card featuring a personal photo of Zhao.
"Why... would you even want something like this? In terms of actual value, it's less useful than my employee ID..."
"A keepsake? Well... okay. As long as you like it. But you're not allowed to take it outside, alright?"
"Not even my coworkers have seen this photo."
